home.js.why: The home page's JavaScript, gzip: the showcase must stay fast. main before the showcase measured 238.7.

home.css.why: The stylesheets the home page loads, gzip: Kirana's compiled stylesheet and the registry's reset and fonts.

docs.js.why: A docs page's JavaScript, gzip: the docs framework, its markdown components and the page's preview frame.

create.js.why: /create's JavaScript, gzip: the editor, its pickers and dialogs.

preview.dialog-demo.js.why: A React preview page, the dialog demo, gzip: the demo as a bare island, without the site's shell, measured 169 KB.

site.css.why: Kirana's compiled stylesheet for the site, gzip, every style and axis value in it: estimated at 88 KB with every axis value at 64 components.

preview-vue.css.why: The Vue preview app's stylesheet, gzip, the same per framework.

registry.files.why: The registry's JSON files under /r: with the rest of the site they must stay under the Worker's 20,000 static files per version.

registry.bytes.why: The registry's JSON, total: it grows with items × combinations, about 19 MB expected at 64 components.

registry.largest.why: The largest registry file: the Worker serves no static file over 25 MiB.

static.files.why: Every static file the Worker serves: its limit is 20,000 per version.
